title: Filters, complete result set, and totals
acceptanceCriteria: API, UI, URL, Excel, pagination, and totals represent one complete filtered queryset with correct units and unset semantics.

defects.title: Client-side aggregation on page slice instead of whole queryset
defects.description: Page 1 shows 50 and Page 2 shows 1 when 51 records match. Totals change upon pagination navigation.

defects.title: Missing whole-queryset totals/aggregates payload in ActivityLogView API
defects.description: API response only returns standard pagination envelope without aggregated headcount or unit-grouped quantities across the full filtered queryset.

defects.title: Missing discipline, block, and contractor filters on Daily Reports list
defects.description: Daily reports list only supports date range and status filters, lacking standard FR016 project dimensions.

defects.title: Collapsing unset/unmeasured quantities into numeric zero
defects.description: Unset semantics conflated with 0 in UI reduction.

defects.title: Misleading man-days labeling for raw headcount row sum
defects.description: Raw headcount sum labeled as 'مجموع نفرات (نفر-روز)' violating D07 decision.

summary: Requirement B04 is qa_failed. The activity log computes summary aggregates solely on the 50-row client page slice rather than the entire filtered queryset, causing totals to jump upon pagination and diverge from full Excel exports. Daily reports list also lacks discipline/block/contractor filters.
